semiconductor_relevance: High — ASMADE specializes in high-precision semiconductor packaging equipment, which is critical for the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: ASMADE (SHENZHEN) TECHNOLOGY LIMITED is a national high-tech enterprise focused on the research and development of advanced semiconductor packaging equipment. They provide a range of solutions including die bonders and packaging process management systems, catering to the needs of the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.China: ASMADE is based in Shenzhen, focusing on the domestic semiconductor market.
